# v2.5 New Features

For new features, toggles, and upgrade instructions, see [v2.5 Release Notes](发布说明-v2.5.md).

# Minecraft Desktop Pet v2.5.3

Created by GPT 6 Astra

## Startup

Double-click **Minecraft Desktop Pet.exe** (or **Minecraft桌宠.exe**). No installation or runtime required. The settings panel opens on first launch; subsequent launches remember your last preferences. The final binary is less than 1 MB and does not bundle or unpack hundreds of megabytes of browser runtimes. The settings panel and window title display the current version number.

The settings panel has three pages:
- **General**: Skin, posture, typing mode, main hand, desktop settings, and autostart on login.
- **Look & Rotation**: Overall orientation and six head tracking parameters.
- **Custom Pose**: Adjust individual body part angles.

## First-Run Default Settings

Default posture is sitting, slim arms, precise typing, right-hand wave, 100% scale, 120 FPS, and 20% typing squash. Always on top, full click-through, mouse tracking, global keyboard interaction, and skin outer layers are enabled by default; hyp quick team chat is off by default. The skin uses the built-in "Forest Traveler", positioned automatically in the bottom-right of the screen workspace containing the mouse cursor. Existing settings are preserved across upgrades.

**Full mouse click-through is enabled by default. To drag the pet, double-click the tray icon to open Settings and uncheck "Click-Through".** The tray icon may be located in the taskbar hidden icon overflow area.

Default head parameters: horizontal sensitivity 100%, range ±85°, center 0°; vertical sensitivity 38%, range ±85°, center 0°. "Reset Tracking" uses standard defaults.

The "GitHub" button at the bottom opens the project repository in your default web browser to view source code, report issues, or download updates.

## Basic Controls

| Action | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Left-drag character or keyboard | Move anywhere on screen |
| Right-click character or tray icon | Switch posture and preferences |
| Double-click character or tray icon | Open Settings panel |
| Click mouse button (left, right, middle, side) | Swing selected main hand once; triggers globally |
| Move mouse cursor | Head turns toward cursor on the next frame without slow lag |
| Hold Left / Right Shift while standing | Instantly switches to sneak; release to return |
| Press keys in other applications while sitting | Character types on the grey keyboard in sync |
| Close Settings panel | Desktop pet continues running in the background |
| Tray menu → Exit Minecraft Desktop Pet | Exit completely |

Transparent empty regions let mouse clicks pass through automatically. When "Click-Through" is enabled, hovering the cursor over visible parts of the character or keyboard smoothly reduces overall opacity to 25%; moving the cursor away or disabling click-through restores full opacity. Fade-out and restoration take ~0.15s with smooth transitions. While click-through is enabled, clicks pass through the pet to windows behind it; manage settings via the system tray. Use "Recenter" if you lose track of the pet. Scale is adjustable from 65% to 180%.

Frame rate offers **30, 60, 90, 120, 144, 165, 240 FPS** options. Default is 120 FPS. Changes take effect immediately and are saved automatically. Stops drawing when idle to save CPU.

When "Always on Top" is checked, the window level is maintained even when switching between applications.

## Skins

Click "Import Skin…" or drag and drop a PNG onto the pet or settings window. Supports modern 64×64, legacy 64×32, and high-resolution skins up to 1024×1024 and 8 MB. Modern skins support classic (4 px) or slim (3 px) arms; legacy skins use classic arms. Outer layers can be toggled on or off.

Imported skins are copied to the application data directory; deleting the original file does not affect the app. "Reset Skin" restores the original built-in Forest Traveler skin.

## Fetching Skins with Official ID

Enter a **Java Edition username or UUID** in "Original ID" and click "Fetch Skin". The app downloads the current skin from Mojang official servers, automatically identifies arm models, and saves it locally; no passwords needed. If the account wears an official cape, it will be downloaded and equipped on the character's back (can be toggled in General settings).

## hyp Quick Team Chat

Enable **hyp quick team chat** on the General page. When you type `#` on your keyboard, it is automatically replaced with `/p chat ` followed by a space.

Disabled by default. Works across applications. Does not send messages automatically; does not alter the clipboard.

## Typing Modes

- **Precise**: Letters, number row, F1–F12, punctuation, and modifiers select the corresponding arm and direction by physical position.
- **Alternating**: Each keystroke alternates between left and right hands.

"Typing Squash" can be adjusted from 0% to 30% (default 20%). Each keystroke briefly compresses the character body, recovering within ~0.28s.

## Main Hand, Overall Angle & Custom Pose

Choose "Right hand" or "Left hand" wave in General settings or via the right-click menu.

In "Look & Rotation", adjust Pitch (X), Yaw (Y), and Roll (Z) from −180° to +180°.

In "Custom Pose", choose "Standing" or "Sitting" to customize angles for Head, Body, Left Arm, Right Arm, Left Leg, and Right Leg. Poses for standing and sitting are saved independently.

## Head Tracking

Horizontal and vertical axes each have three sliders:
- **Sensitivity** (0%–300%): Turn rate relative to cursor distance.
- **Range** (±0°–±85°): Maximum angle from center.
- **Center Offset** (−60°–+60°): Left/right and up/down bias.

## Autostart on Login

Check **Start with Windows** on the General page or right-click menu. Writes to `HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run`. Requires no administrator privileges.

## Settings & Storage

Saved under: `%APPDATA%\minecraft-desktop-pet`.
- `settings.json` / `settings.json.bak`: All user preferences.
- `head-follow.json` / `head-follow.json.bak`: Head tracking backup.
- `skin.png`: Imported skin.

## System Compatibility

Windows 10/11 x64.
Does not record or upload keystrokes. Only connects to official Mojang servers for skin downloads and GitHub for update checks.
Independent fan work; not affiliated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft.
